ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure contains two line charts, left and right; the left figure shows the output proportions of the three major industries in Henan Province from 1995 to 2010, and the right figure shows the employment proportions. The vertical axis of the left figure is percentage, and the horizontal axis is year; the legend shows that the three curves respectively correspond to the primary industry, secondary industry, and tertiary industry. In the left figure, the secondary industry curve is generally located at the top, rising from around 45% to close to 60%; the primary industry curve generally declines, and the tertiary industry curve fluctuates in the middle position, both lower than the secondary industry curve. Reasoning: The question asks for the industry with the “largest output proportion,” so it is only necessary to look at the output proportion chart in the left figure. Comparing the heights of the three curves in the left figure year by year, the secondary industry curve is higher than the primary industry and tertiary industry throughout 1995—2010, so the industry with the largest output proportion is the secondary industry.
